title: Google Trekker field team on the Routeburn Track, published 2015
credit: Department of Conservation; photographer not separately identified for this group photograph.
altText: Three members of the Routeburn field team with the Google Trekker camera visible beside them.
caption: Matt Jenke, Peter Hiemstra and Riki Mules on the Routeburn Track, as identified in DOC’s November 2015 account. The photograph’s exact capture date is unstated.
